description: This file is a C header defining function prototypes for secure process handling functions such as v_secure_popen, v_secure_pclose, and v_secure_system. It includes licensing information and ensures C linkage in C++ projects.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Prototype for opening a process by creating a pipe, for reading or writing a process's standard streams.

methods.name: v_secure_pclose
methods.description: Prototype for closing the pipe opened by v_secure_popen.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Prototype for executing a command in the shell, returning its status.
